mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate weakening demand, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion regimes, industrial production below 102.0 signals economic deceleration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 102.0 during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1450 thousand units signal housing sector contraction, reducing consumer spending and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1450.0.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll employment above 150,000 thousand persons indicates labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 102.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing economic growth momentum and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 102.0.
